entries.zh: 念；背诵、凭记忆诵读（如念书、念经）
entries.en: to say from memory; to recite aloud, to read over
to curse, revile; to speak bad words

entries.zh: 责人以过、把过错推给他人〔字面「体托」不成词，释义存疑〕
entries.en: prob. to reproach another with his faults, to throw one's blame on another (textually uncertain)
entries.notes: 「体托」二字不成词且与官话对音不合，仅据西语词头暂拟，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 讥讽地说、说挖苦话〔字形存疑〕
entries.en: to say something ironically; to mock with a taunt (uncertain)
entries.notes: 首字存疑（撓/橈），字义与「讥讽」难以互证，暂依西语词头；官话栏次音节污损难辨。

entries.en: to speak in praise; to extol, laud
entries.notes: 首字存疑（揭/揚）——「揭」不训称颂，当为「揚」，系推断而定；闽南栏首音形污损。

entries.zh: 戏谑；开玩笑、出言风趣带谑
entries.en: to jest, banter; to say something wittily and mockingly
entries.notes: 首字存疑（謔/謚），西语 landre 疑为讹字，谑义据 donaire（风趣）与「謔」常训拟定。

entries.en: to chant, murmur; to recite softly to oneself
entries.notes: 闽南栏读音与「吟」不合，疑传抄或识读有误；义据西语、汉字与官话对音三栏互定。

entries.zh: 命判套语「旺夫益子」（谓命相旺夫、益子嗣）；为人占断吉运
entries.en: a fortune-teller's verdict 'prospers the husband, benefits the sons'; to divine good fortune
entries.notes: 第三字存疑（盆/益）——「盆」不成义，当为「益」，合「旺夫益子」命书常语，四字对音亦相应。

entries.zh: 看命；算命、推人命运吉凶
entries.en: to tell fortunes; to look into a person's fate
entries.notes: 首字存疑（看/省），据栏内对音与「看命」常语定为「看」。

entries.zh: 相人面；相面（察人脸面以断吉凶祸福）
entries.en: to tell fortune by reading a person's face; physiognomy
to calculate and forecast fate; fortune-telling
to tell another, report and communicate it
entries.notes: 官话栏次字两形存疑，但两形皆对应「说」，不碍释义；词头 consagelo 疑为讹字，义取「告知他人」。

entries.zh: 解明；解说分明、解释清楚
entries.en: to explain clearly; to declare, make plain

entries.zh: 肺腑之言；由衷吐露真言〔末字存疑〕
entries.en: words from the bottom of the heart; to tell the truth sincerely
entries.notes: 末字存疑（咀/唱），当为「肺腑之言」类真言套语，与西语「道出实情」相合。

entries.en: to cry out in pain; to complain of an ache
entries.notes: 词头缩写 g 当为 que 之展开（decir que duele）；首字存疑（叫/吐），「叫痛」与词义正合。

entries.zh: 自称「不识、不知」之辞〔首字存疑，释义存疑〕
entries.en: prob. the retort 'I don't know, I can't find it' (uncertain)
entries.notes: 首字存疑（轘/識），两字音读互异难以互证，暂依西语「言己所不知」拟定「不识」义。

entries.zh: 评人；贬评他人、说人坏话
entries.en: to speak ill of a person; to disparage, criticize someone

entries.zh: 评省；讥评责省、数落人过
entries.en: to reproach and carp at; to speak evil, finding fault
entries.notes: 「評省」连文少见，「省」取责省义，义据词头「口出恶言」拟定。

entries.en: to utter, say out; to divulge, spit out (words)
entries.notes: 字存疑（吐/叫），取「吐」之吐露义合词头 Decir。
